newsitem.title: USA: Maine sets $42.7 mln GO bond sale around May 13.
newsitem.headline: Maine sets $42.7 mln GO bond sale around May 13.

text.p: Maine, which typically only sells general obligation bonds once a year, said Tuesday it planned a $42.7 million offering around May 13 via a syndicate that will be led by PaineWebber.
"This will be it for 1997," said Maurice Stickney, deputy treasurer for the state.
The deputy treasurer added that the funds would be used for capital projects, like environmental and highway construction and school buildings.
